{{Short description|Israeli biophysicist and systems biologist}}
'''Nathalie Q. Balaban''' ({{Langx|he|נטלי בלבן}}) is an [[Israel|Israeli]][[biophysics| biophysicist]] and [[systems biology | systems biologist]]. She is a [[Full Professor|full professor]] at the [[Racah Institute of Physics]] at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]].<ref>{{Citation | title = Prof. Nathalie Balaban, The Racah Institute of Physics | publisher= Racah Institute of Physics, [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] | url = https://phys.huji.ac.il/contacts/balaban-questembert_nathalie | postscript =  }}</ref> and a member of the [[European Academy of Microbiology]] (EAM), the [[American Academy of Microbiology]] (AAM) and the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO).

== Education and career ==

Balaban completed her [[PhD]] degree in [[Condensed matter physics|Condensed Matter Physics]] at the [[Weizmann Institute of Science|Weizmann Institute]]. She first became interested in biophysics and studied mechanical forces in cells with Benny Geiger in 2000. She then joined [[Stanislas Leibler | Stanislas Leibler’s]] lab in [[Princeton University]] as a postdoctoral researcher, where she was a [[Robert H. Dicke Fellowship|Robert H. Dicke]] Fellow. Since 2003, she has been a [[faculty member]] in the Physics Department of the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem|Hebrew University]].
Her research today focuses on the biophysical description of the responses of bacteria under antibiotic treatments,<ref name="Nature Reviews Microbiology 2019">{{cite journal |last1=Balaban |first1=N. == Recognition ==
* The [[Wolf Prize|Krill prize]] from the [[Wolf Foundation]] for Excellence in Scientific Research in 2009.<ref name="Krill Prize">{{cite web |title=Nathalie Q. Balaban, Krill Prize Laureate 2009 |work=Wolf Foundation |date=8 January 2020 |url=https://wolffund.org.il/2020/01/08/nathalie-questembert-balaban/}}</ref>

* The Klachky Prize for the Advancement of the Frontiers of Science in 2016.<ref name="Nathalie Balaban, AcademiaNet">{{cite web |title=Nathalie Balaban, AcademiaNet|url=https://www.academia-net.org/profil/prof-dr-nathalie-balaban/1135371//}}</ref> 

* Elected member of the [[European Academy of Microbiology]] (EAM) in 2016.<ref name="EAM">{{cite web |title=EAM - members |url=https://fems-microbiology.org/eam-members//}}</ref> 

* Elected Fellow of the [[American Academy of Microbiology]] (AAM) in 2018.<ref name="Nathalie Balaban, AcademiaNet"></ref>
* Elected Member of the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO) in 2021<ref name="EMBO">{{cite web |title=Nathalie Balaban, EMBO website |url=https://people.embo.org/profile/nathalie-q-balaban/}}</ref>
* Excelling researcher in all research fields at the Hebrew University for the year of 2022 <ref name="Excelling researcher">{{cite web |title=Excelling researcher 2022 |url=https://en-science.huji.ac.il/news/%C2%A0warm-greetings-prof%C2%A0nathalie-balaban-racah-institute%C2%A0}}</ref>

== Dissemination ==
Balaban initiated and established, together with Professor Eran Sharon  the "Scholar-Teacher"   which creates academic research positions at the Hebrew University that include also part-time science teaching in high schools for the advancement of science teaching.
